news.headline: WTI Crude Hovers Around $100: Are Oilfield Stocks a Smart Bet Now?
news.summary: WTI crude near $100 may bolster oilfield activity, with Baker Hughes and Oceaneering poised to benefit from stronger drilling and offshore demand.

news.headline: Chord Energy's $550M Marcellus Exit Sharpens Its Williston Focus
news.summary: CHRD's $550M Marcellus sale sharpens its focus on core Williston Basin assets, lowers leverage and capital spending, and increases oil weighting.

news.headline: California Resources to Divest Uinta Basin Assets for $90 Million
news.summary: CRC plans to sell its non-core Uinta Basin assets for about $90 million, freeing cash to support its California-focused strategy and capital allocation.

news.headline: Transocean Boosts Backlog With New Deepwater Conqueror Deal
news.summary: RIG secures an $80 million Equatorial Guinea deal, keeping Deepwater Conqueror contracted after its Gulf of Mexico assignment ends.

news.headline: ENB Restarts Line 5 With Temporary Bypass Following Wisconsin Incident
news.summary: Enbridge restores Line 5 through a temporary bypass, limiting disruption and preserving energy flows to Midwest and Great Lakes refineries.
